item.subject: Mathematics
item.stem:
[Image: A scale with a pointer]

On the scale above, what number does the pointer indicate?
item.figure_description:
A scale shaped as a circular sector with a curved arc at the top and straight sides meeting at a bottom vertex. Along the curved arc, there are evenly spaced tick marks:
- An unlabeled tick mark near the left end
- A tick mark labeled 300
- An unlabeled tick mark
- A tick mark to which a pointer arrow (originating from the bottom vertex) points
- Two unlabeled tick marks
- A tick mark labeled 400
- An unlabeled tick mark near the right end
item.calibration: Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2003 data, 2007 bridging data, and 2007 data (fourth-grade mathematics).

reference_items.subject: Mathematics
reference_items.stem: The scale on a map indicates that 1 centimeter on the map represents 4 kilometers on the land. The distance between two towns on the map is 8 centimeters. How many kilometers apart are the two towns?
reference_items.calibration: Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2007 and 2011 fourth-grade mathematics data.

reference_items.subject: Mathematics
reference_items.stem:
[Image: a scale in grams weighing three apples]

How much do the apples weigh in grams?
reference_items.figure_description: A dial scale with three apples resting on the weighing platform at the top. The circular dial is labeled "grams" in the center. The scale is marked with numbers clockwise starting from 0 at the top, then 50, 100, 150, 200 (at the bottom), 250, 300, and 350. Between every two numbered intervals of 50 grams, there are tick marks dividing the interval into 5 equal subdivisions of 10 grams each. A pointer extends from the center and points directly to the second tick mark clockwise past 200.
reference_items.calibration: Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2007 and 2011 fourth-grade mathematics data.

reference_items.subject: Mathematics
reference_items.stem:
[Image: A triangle on top of a rectangle]

The figure above is made from a rectangle and a triangle with three equal sides.
What is the length, in centimeters, of side AB ?
reference_items.figure_description: A composite figure composed of a rectangle at the bottom and a triangle on top sharing the rectangle's top edge as its base. The rectangle's bottom horizontal side is labeled "8 cm", and its right vertical side is labeled "3 cm". The triangle's top vertex is labeled A, and its bottom-right vertex (which is also the top-right corner of the rectangle) is labeled B.

reference_items.subject: Mathematics
reference_items.stem:
[Image: a piece of string curved both ends and a rule in cm with value from 1 to 10.]

If the string in the diagram above is pulled straight, which of these is closest to its length?
reference_items.figure_description:
A metric ruler and a folded piece of string above it. The ruler has major tick marks labeled from 1 to 10 with "cm" before the 1, and intermediate half-centimeter tick marks between each number.

The string is laid horizontally above the ruler with both ends folded back:
- The bottom-left end starts at the 4 cm mark and extends left to the 3 cm mark, where it loops around 180 degrees.
- The middle section runs continuously to the right from the 3 cm mark to approximately the 8 cm mark.
- At approximately the 8 cm mark, it loops around 180 degrees upward and extends back to the left, ending at approximately the 6.5 cm mark.
reference_items.calibration: Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2007 and 2011 fourth-grade mathematics data.

reference_items.subject: Mathematics
reference_items.stem:
[Image: a complex figure shaped like a bow tie with lines of symmetry shaded on faded square lines.]

How many lines of symmetry does this figure have?
reference_items.figure_description:
A shaded, symmetric bow-tie-shaped polygon is drawn on a grid of squares measuring 6 columns wide and 4 rows high.
- The shape has two vertical outer ends: a left vertical side along the first interior vertical grid line spanning the middle 2 units in height, and an identical right vertical side along the fifth vertical grid line spanning the middle 2 units in height.
- From the top and bottom endpoints of each vertical side, the top and bottom edges slope inward toward a narrower central "neck."
- At the center of the figure, the top and bottom boundaries each form a short horizontal segment parallel to the grid lines.
- The figure is horizontally and vertically symmetric across the central vertical grid line and the central horizontal grid line.
reference_items.calibration: Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2007 and 2011 fourth-grade mathematics data.

slope.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 1-point item with the three-parameter logistic (3PL) model, which TIMSS uses for multiple-choice items, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2003 data, 2007 bridging data, and 2007 data (fourth-grade mathematics)". What is the item's slope (discrimination) parameter a? A higher a means that the item separates students of lower and higher mathematics ability more sharply. Choose the value closest to it. The state also lists reference items: the calibrated TIMSS items of the same grade most similar to this one (never the item itself or its other parts), most similar first, with their percent correct and their calibrated parameters, each on the scale of its own calibration. Use them to place this item.
